hooks.command: main=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null); wt=$(jq -r '.path // .worktree_path // .worktree // empty' 2>/dev/null); [ -n "$wt" ] && [ -n "$main" ] && mkdir -p "$wt/.claude" && cp "$main/.claude/settings.local.json" "$wt/.claude/settings.local.json" 2>/dev/null; true

staged=$(git diff --cached --name-only 2>/dev/null); cli_go=$(echo "$staged" | grep -E '^(cmd/|internal/cli/).*\.go$'); docs=$(echo "$staged" | grep -E '^(README\.md|docs/)'); if [ -n "$cli_go" ] && [ -z "$docs" ]; then printf '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","additionalContext":"CLI-facing Go files changed but no docs updated. Verify README.md reflects any command, flag, or behavior changes."}}'; fi
